title: ZPA authentication: IdP configuration, authentication settings and user risk scores

prose.text: "How does a user or admin authenticate to Private Access, and what is configured for it?" takes six questions.

steps.label: How is the IdP set up?
steps.text: Fields, User and Admin SSO, arbitrary domains and the policy settings: [[zpa.authentication.idp-configuration]].

steps.label: Is a certificate expiring or being rotated?
steps.text: IdP certificate expiry and service provider certificate rotation: [[zpa.authentication.idp-certificates]].

steps.label: Is the tenant moving to a new IdP?
steps.text: The two methods, prerequisites and fallback: [[zpa.authentication.idp-migration]].

steps.label: What does the IdP side need?
steps.text: Per-IdP guides for Okta, OneLogin, PingOne, Azure AD, ADFS and SafeNet: [[zpa.authentication.idp-guides]].

steps.label: What are the tenant-wide options?
steps.text: Admin SSO enforcement, CORS, SameSite, session timeout and authentication domains: [[zpa.authentication.settings]].

steps.label: How are user risk scores shown and overridden?

prose.text: SAML attributes are in [[zpa.saml-attributes]] and SCIM in [[zpa.scim]]. Authentication failures are in [[zpa.troubleshooting.authentication]], and the Client Connector error codes in [[zcc.troubleshooting.private-access-auth-errors]].
